## panBy() function

Shifts the visible window by `dx`<!-- -->/`dy` data units (positive = pan right/down), clamped to stay within the data extent.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function panBy(viewport: Viewport, dx: number, dy: number): Viewport;
```
